description: HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer UI that allows browsing databases, tables, and viewing table data with dynamic loading, search, and expand/collapse features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets content.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders a data table with data rows and columns.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cells, handling objects, long text, and nulls with expand/collapse functionality.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
